step.command: set -eu; profile_root="${BPFREJIT_SPECIALIZATION_PROFILE_ROOT:?BPFREJIT_SPECIALIZATION_PROFILE_ROOT is required for hot_region_version}"; profile="${profile_root}/hot_region_version/hash-${PROG_HASH}.json"; source_prog_id=$(jq -er '.source_prog_id | select(type == "number")' "${profile}"); raw="${profile_root}/../raw/${source_prog_id}.json"; bpfopt --pass hot_region_version --input "${INPUT}" --output "${OUTPUT}" --report "${REPORT}" --prog-type "${PROG_TYPE}" -- --profile "${profile}" --program-hash "${PROG_HASH}"; candidates="${REPORT}.candidates.txt"; jq -r ' .per_site | to_entries | map(select( (.value.branch_count | type) == "number" and (.value.taken | type) == "number" and (.value.not_taken | type) == "number" and .value.branch_count >= 100 and .value.taken + .value.not_taken == .value.branch_count and .value.taken != .value.not_taken and (([.value.taken, .value.not_taken] | max) * 1000 >= .value.branch_count * 800) )) | sort_by([-.value.branch_count, (.key | tonumber)]) | .[].key ' "${raw}" > "${candidates}"; while IFS= read -r pc; do candidate_profile="${REPORT}.candidate-${pc}.profile.json"; candidate_report="${REPORT}.candidate-${pc}.report.json"; candidate_output="${REPORT}.candidate-${pc}.bpf"; jq --arg pc "${pc}" --slurpfile raw "${raw}" ' .per_site = { ($pc): ($raw[0].per_site[$pc] | {branch_count, taken, not_taken}) } ' "${profile}" > "${candidate_profile}"; bpfopt --pass hot_region_version --input "${INPUT}" --output "${candidate_output}" --report "${candidate_report}" --prog-type "${PROG_TYPE}" -- --profile "${candidate_profile}" --program-hash "${PROG_HASH}"; applied=$(jq -er '.sites_applied | select(type == "number")' "${candidate_report}"); skipped=$(jq -er '.sites_skipped | select(type == "number")' "${candidate_report}"); if test "${applied}" -eq 1 && test "${skipped}" -eq 0; then install -m 0644 "${candidate_output}" "${OUTPUT}"; install -m 0644 "${candidate_report}" "${REPORT}"; install -m 0644 "${candidate_profile}" "${REPORT}.selected-profile.json"; break; fi; test "${applied}" -eq 0 && test "${skipped}" -eq 1; done < "${candidates}"
